architectural-decision-records.why: records the release and versioning governance decision
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0049: who may cut a release (contributors), semver with the consumer-affecting-red rule, retiring a bad version, emergency fixes, forward-only upgrades, and auto-detect-and-loudly-encourage at session start; mirrored the how-to into CONTRIBUTING
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that this is process not a mechanical gate (nothing forces semver to be applied right), the trusted-contributor residual risk, and that the session-start auto-sync mechanism ships separately
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

verifiable-quality-gates.why: no automated check added or changed; this change records process and policy

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: no executable code; documentation and an ADR only
